description:
Images from CMSA (270 entries), SpaceIL (22 entries), and USAF (40 entries) appear under the 'Wikimedia Commons contributors' section on /credits instead of under their own agency sections

Expected: Agency entries route to their correct source-logos section: CMSA→cnsa, SpaceIL→spaceil, USAF→us-space-force, CSA→csa via agencyToSourceId in the production routing code

Acceptance criteria:
- agencyToSourceId('CMSA') must return 'cnsa' [spec: commit aaaab7f6e (main): `if (a.includes('cmsa')) return 'cnsa'` — fixed on main, missing on this branch]
- agencyToSourceId('SpaceIL') must return 'spaceil' [spec: commit aaaab7f6e (main): `if (a.includes('spaceil') || a.includes('space il')) return 'spaceil'` — fixed on main, missing on this branch]
- agencyToSourceId('USAF') must return 'us-space-force' [spec: commit aaaab7f6e (main): extends the USSF check with `a.includes('usaf')` and `a.includes('air force')` — fixed on main, missing on this branch]
- agencyToSourceId('CSA') must return 'csa' when CSA is the primary agency token [spec: commit aaaab7f6e (main): `if (a === 'csa' || a.startsWith('csa ') || a.startsWith('csa/') || a.includes(' csa')) return 'csa'` — fixed on main, missing on this branch]
- A vitest unit test covering each new mapping (4 new assertions) must pass [spec: commit aaaab7f6e (main) added 27 lines of test coverage + same-commit passing run; no such test exists on this branch]
- The /credits page must render CMSA entries under the CNSA section (not Wikimedia Commons), verified by e2e or visual snapshot [reporter: Original report: 'space agencies show up under Wikimedia Commons instead of where they belong']

Domain facts:
- Commit aaaab7f6e (main) applied the identical fix to src/lib/credits-grouping.ts + added the unit test + added spaceil to source-logos.json. That commit's diff IS the fix prescription.
- The validator script scripts/validate-credits-bundling.ts is a passive monitor that does NOT control the /credits page rendering. Fixing it changes nothing for the user.
- static/data/image-provenance.json contains 270 'CMSA', 22 'SpaceIL', 40 'USAF', 0 'CSA' entries.
- static/data/source-logos.json needs a 'spaceil' entry for the SpaceIL section to render with a heading (main has this; this branch does not).

Target: src/lib/credits-grouping.ts — agencyToSourceId (called by provenanceSourceId)
Do NOT change scripts/validate-credits-bundling.ts — validator mirror, touched in FAIL attempt, does not control /credits page rendering — it is not the owner of this symptom.
